description: This file defines a SwiftUI view component 'ConfigSettings' for configuring application settings via a schema-driven form interface, with supporting nested structures, sections, and subsections.

classes.name: ConfigSettings
classes.description: A SwiftUI View structure for displaying and managing configuration settings based on a schema, with internal state management for sections and subsections.

classes.name: ConfigSection
classes.description: A struct representing a configuration section, identifiable by its key, with associated metadata.

classes.name: ConfigSubsection
classes.description: A struct representing a subsection within a configuration section, identifiable by its key, with associated metadata and schema path.

classes.name: SubsectionSelection
classes.description: An enum to track the currently selected subsection, either all or specified by key.

methods.name: body
methods.description: The primary view rendering method, organizing the layout into sidebar and detail views, with data load handling.

methods.name: sections
methods.description: Computes and returns the list of configuration sections derived from the schema.

methods.name: activeSection
methods.description: Returns the currently active section based on selected key.

methods.name: sidebar
methods.description: Constructs the sidebar view listing all sections and subsections.

methods.name: detail
methods.description: Constructs the detail view for the selected section, showing schema form or status.

methods.name: sectionDetail
methods.description: Builds the detailed view of a specific configuration section.

methods.name: ensureSelection
methods.description: Ensures that a section and subsection are selected appropriately based on current schema.

methods.name: selectSection
methods.description: Sets the active section and initializes its first subsection.

methods.name: resolveSections
methods.description: Resolves and sorts schema nodes into user-friendly sections.

methods.name: resolveSubsections
methods.description: Resolves and sorts properties of a section into subsections.

methods.name: resolvedSchemaNode
methods.description: Resolves anyOf or oneOf variants to a concrete schema node.

methods.name: humanize
methods.description: Converts snake_case or kebab-case keys into human-readable strings.
